headline: OpenAI weighs rebranding data centers amid backlash, eyes 2028 election
summary: OpenAI is considering rebranding its data centers as 'AI compute campuses' as public backlash over electricity and water use grows. The company, through policy chief Chris Lehane, is also positioning itself to shape the 2028 presidential election, proposing a framing for AI's role that it says could benefit Americans while advancing its own business interests.
